scope: The unchanged MovementPulse as CombatPulse configures it: MovementPulse(entity, null) (action `new` with a null target), setLast(null) and setDestination(victim) (action `set`), updatePath() (action `path`); the anonymous subclass answers pulse() with false (pulseResult). CombatPulse.attack, setVictim and the interaction check themselves are combat-pulse-oracle; the pathfinders and the walking queue are their own corpora.
